laws.title: The initial knowledge registry is closed
laws.rule: R0.3 MUST register exactly knowledge.system, knowledge.question, knowledge.investigation, knowledge.experiment and knowledge.claim as its initial RecordKinds.

laws.title: Knowledge kinds are constitutive RecordKinds
laws.rule: Every R0.3 knowledge entity MUST use the constitutive RecordKind and lineage semantics frozen by R0.2 rather than inventing a parallel identity model.

laws.title: System is durable and publication-independent
laws.rule: A knowledge.system Record MUST remain identifiable independently of publication, route, repository, deployment, maturity or current presentation.

laws.title: Questions may remain unresolved
laws.rule: A knowledge.question Record MAY remain open or partially answered indefinitely and MUST NOT acquire synthetic closure merely because later Records exist.

laws.title: Questions relate to Systems without owning them
laws.rule: Question aboutSystemRefs MAY reference knowledge.system Records but MUST NOT redefine their identity, lifecycle, maturity or truth state.

laws.title: Investigations address Questions
laws.rule: A knowledge.investigation Record MUST reference at least one resolvable knowledge.question Record and MUST NOT duplicate inverse investigation lists into the Question payload.

laws.title: Experiments belong to Investigations
laws.rule: A knowledge.experiment Record MUST reference at least one resolvable knowledge.investigation Record and MUST remain independently identifiable from the narrative written about it.

laws.title: Experiment outcome is declared, not proved
laws.rule: An Experiment declaredOutcome MUST be treated as the admitted experiment result field and MUST NOT by itself be presented as operational evidence or proof.

laws.title: Claims are scoped propositions
laws.rule: A knowledge.claim Record MUST contain an explicit statement and scope and MUST NOT be treated as self-validating merely because the Claim exists.

laws.title: Claim epistemic rank is deferred
laws.rule: R0.3 MUST NOT assign supported, established, refuted or equivalent evidence-derived rank to Claims before the R0.4 Evidence Contract defines those semantics.

laws.title: Knowledge relations use logical references
laws.rule: R0.3 graph fields MUST use logical RecordRef values and MUST NOT silently substitute route strings, slugs, filenames or other locators for Record identity.

laws.title: Graph references resolve by target kind
laws.rule: Every admitted R0.3 graph reference MUST resolve to an admitted Record whose RecordKind is permitted by the source field constraint.

laws.title: Reverse relations are projections
laws.rule: Inverse graph relationships MUST be derived from canonical forward references and MUST NOT become a second writable authority that can drift from the source relation.

laws.title: Reference sets are canonical
laws.rule: Set-like RecordRef arrays MUST reject duplicate RecordIds and MUST canonicalize by ascending RecordId before payload serialization.

laws.title: Semantic payloads fail closed
laws.rule: A kind-specific payload MUST reject unknown fields, invalid schema versions, invalid enum values and missing required semantic fields instead of silently admitting them.

laws.title: Payload digests are deterministic
laws.rule: Each R0.3 payload MUST serialize under the frozen canonical JSON profile and MUST bind a SHA-256 PayloadDigest without becoming the logical RecordId.

laws.title: Later contracts cannot arrive early
laws.rule: R0.3 payloads MUST NOT encode Evidence, maturity, visibility, route, language or Publication semantics that are constitutionally assigned to later R0 cuts.

laws.title: Relations preserve endpoint history
laws.rule: Adding or changing a knowledge relation MAY revise the source Record through R0.2 lineage but MUST NOT rewrite the target Record identity or any historical revision.

payload.name: Genesis
payload.thesis: The web can be governed as an operational environment.

payload.prompt: When does a browser stop being merely an application?

payload.title: Browser authority boundary
payload.scope: Separate observation, authorization, action and effect.

payload.title: Authority boundary campaign
payload.protocol: Execute one bounded action and verify proposal, authorization, action, observation and effect remain distinct.
